name: implied_vol_dislocation_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: When India VIX (implied vol) diverges significantly from Nifty50 realized vol (last 20 days annualized), a correction is imminent. If VIX > 1.3 * realized_vol, the market is overpricing fear — go long equities. If VIX < 0.8 * realized_vol, the market is underpricing risk — go short. This inefficiency exists because options market makers set implied vol based on order flow and hedging needs, not pure statistical forecasting. Edge persists because the IV-RV spread requires cross-asset analysis most equity traders don't perform.
stock_filter: top 15 by beta to Nifty50 (maximally sensitive to VIX moves)

indicators.name: rv_20d
indicators.formula: annualized realized vol of Nifty50 over last 20 trading days

long.confirmation: VIX starts declining for 3 consecutive bars

short.confirmation: VIX starts rising for 3 consecutive bars

filters.time_filter: entry only 10:00-13:00 (need time for mean reversion to play out)
filters.event_filter: skip on expiry day, RBI policy day, budget day

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — IV-RV spread is driven by options market structure, slow to change

weaknesses: IV-RV dislocation can persist for days/weeks — intraday resolution is not guaranteed
Using a daily input (20-day RV) in a 1-min strategy creates a mismatch in signal granularity
Very low frequency — dislocation signals fire maybe 3-5 times per month
prior_art: Implied-realized volatility spread trade — standard options/vol arb concept. Applied here to equity direction.
notes: More suitable as a regime overlay than a standalone strategy. Combine with other setups.
